title.id: Artikel baru: Akses Database Makin Mudah, Tapi Privasi Data Sering Bobol
title.en: New article: Database Interfaces Are Getting Better, But Privacy Risks Grow

body.id: Satu tulisan baru ditambahkan ke blog: "Akses Database Makin Mudah, Tapi Privasi Data Sering Bobol". Tulisannya membahas kemudahan antarmuka database seperti ultorg membawa risiko kebocoran data pengguna bila tata kelola akses internal diabaikan begitu saja
body.en: A new article was added to the blog: "Database Interfaces Are Getting Better, But Privacy Risks Grow". It covers visual relational tools like ultorg make database exploration fast, yet neglected internal permissions create critical data leak hazards
